metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: Reaching Cina after some more adventures, Sawérigading disguises himself as a merchant and uses the skin of the face of the king of the Oro, La Pabokori, as a mask to enter the palace La Tanété. He is able to steal a glimpse of I Wé Cudaiq, the daughter of La Sattung Mpugiq, king of Cina. He proposes, and in the course of the following three months the dowry is transferred.
